confidence.rationale: Macro 02.2 converged 125 historical nodes by binding each probe to its own checkpoint while preserving its assertions; independent validation beyond this mission is still required.

decision_rules: A historical probe must read the source, fixtures, repository state, and Git diff endpoint of its own checkpoint.
A current-contract test must continue to read the current worktree and index rather than inherit a historical snapshot.
An adapter may change the evidence endpoint but may not remove assertions, broaden permissions, or make a protected path allowable.

evidence_refs.claim: The baseline contains 125 individually ledgered historical failures across explicit cause clusters.
The ledgered historical node set passes without skips, xfails, assertion deletion, or product changes.

failure_modes: Compare an old assertion against the current worktree and misclassify later legitimate work as a historical defect.
Use a broad current snapshot to make an old test green while hiding a real contract change.
Let an historical adapter alter protected product paths or test authority.

notes: Deep historical validation is made reproducible by selecting an explicit checkpoint evidence endpoint.
Historical test convergence preserves checkpoint identity rather than rewriting inherited history.

preconditions: The historical test node and its checkpoint are identified by full or resolvable Git revision.
The current contract and protected path policy are known.
procedure: Record the historical node and exact checkpoint in the failure ledger.
Resolve source files, fixtures, repository reads, and Git diff commands against that checkpoint.
Execute the original assertions without skip, xfail, deletion, or mass snapshot regeneration.
Run current-contract tests separately against the current worktree and inspect the protected diff.
Record the classification, evidence endpoint, and final node result.
recovery: If the endpoint adapter needs product logic, stop and classify the case as a contract frontier.
If a historical result remains ambiguous, preserve the failure and evidence rather than forcing green.
Rollback only the uncommitted adapter station; preserve prior ledger commits.
stop_conditions: Stop on a product, backend, payload, runtime, endpoint, integration, or authority change request.
Stop on an unresolved distinction between obsolete expectation and current-contract regression.
Never make a global guard permissive to satisfy one historical node.
summary: Historical tests become trustworthy when each probe is evaluated against its own checkpoint evidence endpoint while current tests remain current.
title: Historical checkpoints require an explicit evidence endpoint
validation: The Macro 02.2 ledgered set passes 125 of 125 nodes after bounded endpoint adaptation.
The current 1.192 guard remains deny-by-default and protected product diff checks remain empty.
